maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mostly water and wastewater utility service billed to customers, not repair or replacement of installed products.

publicly_funded.reason: Regulated water utility billing households, businesses and fire protection customers; contract operations for municipalities are the smaller part.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through regulated rate base investment in its New Jersey and Delaware systems, with only occasional system acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Regulated drinking water and wastewater utility; customers in its service territory cannot easily switch suppliers.
